text:
alex: seeing weird tail latency in eu-west dedicated pools since ~02:10 UTC, small spikes ~250-500ms for short requests
mira: any correlation with embeddings or heavy kv cache churn? saw a couple of tenants ramping batch-embed jobs earlier
alex: yes, graph shows kv-cache evictions aligning with spikes. tenant ids A23 and B77 have high prefix reuse. wondering if noisy neighbor is spilling into dedicated slices
raj: hm. dedicated slices should isolate GPU but not egress kv/warm cache pressure. are these slices sharing the same proxy/egress bridge?
alex: yes — they share the same egress MGW in rack-12 region-eu-west-2. net stats show bursty egress queue length at 02:09:55
oncall-bot: Incident detected: tail-latency-spike-eu-west-02:10. Pager muted for ops on-call.
jordan: can you paste the small snippet from the mgw logs? also any kernel queue drops?
alex: paste: ```
02:09:54 WARN mgw/egress_queue.go:312 queue_len=87 tenant=A23 burst=12ms
02:09:55 WARN mgw/egress_queue.go:312 queue_len=102 tenant=B77 burst=20ms
02:09:56 INFO kvcache/evictor.go:121 evicted=432 tenant=A23 reason=workset-spike
``` 
mira: looks like NVMe-backed kv evictions triggering request replays and causing head-of-line on the egress bridge
raj: options: (1) carve out dedicated egress lanes per reserved slice (expensive HW-wise) (2) soft-carveout via tokenized rate shaping (3) prefill warm pool to reduce kv pressure (4) route heavy embed tenants to separate proxy
alex: cost/ops tradeoff: option 1 requires VLAN+HW changes per customer; 4 is easiest but requires routing policy + tagging change and possible performance variance
jordan: could we try a quick soft-carveout: set a per-tenant egress policer for A23/B77 at 60% of recent 95th, and increase warm-pool prefill on the slice for 5m window to observe?
mira: +1. also enable trace sampling on mgw for those tenant IDs for 10 minutes so we can see if egress shaping reduces kv evictions
alex: scheduled a short run: `./opsctl set-policy --tenant A23,B77 --egress-rate 0.6 --window 5m` kicking in at 02:30 UTC
oncall-bot: Policy change applied by alex (dry-run=false): egress-rate=0.6 tenants=[A23,B77]
raj: do we have fallback routing ready if this causes SLA breach for those tenants? need canary route to eu-west-2b separate proxy
jordan: add fallback: set route tag `fallback-proxy=eu2b-proxy-03` and enable automatic failover when latency >300ms for >30s
alex: done. also bumped warm pool prefill: `kv-prefill set --slice dedicated-eu-warm --minutes 10`
mira: monitoring: dashboards updated, setting alert: kv-eviction-rate > 200/min for 3m
alex: running now. initial telemetry shows evictions down ~40% in first 3m, tail latency improved ~120ms 95th -> 95th
raj: nice. keep the egress policer for 30 minutes then gradual ramp down. we should write a followup RFC for longer term: egress-lane-carveout vs smarter proxy sharding
jordan: can we add cost estimate in RFC? HW VLAN carveouts likely +$X/month per AZ vs proxy routing (software) cheaper but operational complexity
alex: will draft RFC. for now keep the controls in place and observe for 2 hours, then revert if stable. thanks all :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident resolved? No further alerts in past 15m. Marking as monitored.
